首页/联系我们

联系我们

商务合作、功能建议、问题反馈——我们都欢迎。

商务与合作

如有商务合作、品牌联名、内容授权等需求，请发送邮件至 cataisvip@gmail.com。我们会在收到后尽快回复，并视合作方向安排专人对接。

功能建议与问题反馈

发现 bug、想要新功能，或对我们的工具/指南有任何想法，最快捷的方式是在 GitHub Issues 提交。开源社区的力量能让工具变得更好，每一条反馈我们都会认真阅读。

我们能帮你解决什么

图标工坊、Favicon、图片压缩、配色工具的使用问题；ICO / PNG / WebP / favicon 相关的格式疑问；以及「该用哪个工具、怎么导出才符合规范」这类选型建议。如果你不确定从哪入手，直接来信描述你的场景即可。

开源贡献

cataito 完全开源。你可以通过提交 Issue 报告问题，或发起 Pull Request 改进代码、补充指南、修正翻译。我们在仓库里维护着待办清单，欢迎认领。

关于回复时间

我们是一支小规模团队，邮件通常在 1–3 个工作日内回复。GitHub Issues 的响应可能取决于社区与维护者的排期，但重要的安全问题会优先处理。

隐私说明

出于隐私考虑，我们不公开个人电话号码与实体地址。所有沟通均通过上面列出的公开邮箱与 GitHub 进行。关于我们如何处理你的信息，请参阅隐私政策。

Business and collaboration

For business collaboration, brand partnership, or content licensing, email cataisvip@gmail.com. We'll reply as soon as we can and assign a point of contact based on the topic.

Feature requests and feedback

Found a bug, want a new feature, or have thoughts on our tools or guides? The fastest route is to open a ticket in GitHub Issues. The open-source community helps make the tools better, and we read every piece of feedback.

What we can help with

Usage questions for IconForge, Favicon, Compressor, and Palette; format questions around ICO / PNG / WebP / favicon; and "which tool should I use, how do I export to spec" advice. If you're unsure where to start, just email your scenario.

Open-source contributions

cataito is fully open source. You can report problems via Issues or send Pull Requests to improve code, add guides, or fix translations. We maintain a todo list in the repository—feel free to claim a task.

About response time

We're a small team; emails are usually answered within 1–3 business days. GitHub Issue responses depend on community and maintainer schedules, but security issues are prioritized.

Privacy note

For privacy reasons we do not publish a personal phone number or physical address. All communication goes through the public email and GitHub listed above. For how we handle your information, see our Privacy Policy.
